meaning: The number 807 has no well-established symbolic meaning in biblical or Jewish tradition.
description: 807 is mentioned in Genesis 5:7 as the number of years Seth lived after he had his son Enosh, but the number itself is not attributed any special symbolic or mystical significance in traditional biblical exegesis or Jewish numerology (gematria). It functions primarily as a chronological indication in the genealogies of Genesis. Some may attempt to break it down into component numbers (e.g., 800 + 7), but this is not an acknowledged traditional practice specifically tied to this number.
